buy_title: The pick: the Jackery Explorer 2000 v2, and the price to wait for
buy_total: The button shows today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Our price bands come from US retailers, brand stores and deal threads on the dates named.

cards.name: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
cards.badge: Power station · our top pick to wait for
cards.price: List $1,499 (Slickdeals threads, Nov 2025). Wellbots sold it for $599 with a code on Nov 14, 2025 (Slickdeals). Our target: under $700.
cards.buy_if: you want multi-day outage backup and can wait for a mid-to-late November sale: it is the one pick here with a documented low in the Black Friday window, at well under half its list price.
cards.skip_if: you may want to add batteries later (it does not expand), or the page shows the $1,499 "was" price with only a modest cut. That list price is rarely paid.
cards.owners: Best Buy's standalone listing had 7 reviews, mostly four or five stars, with one firmware bug that needed a hard reset (snapshot, Oct 2026). Its solar bundle showed 2.3 out of 5 from 3 reviews, and two reviewers said the panels were missing from the box (snapshot, Oct 2026). TechRadar gave the unit 4.5 stars.
cards.video_title: Jackery's New Explorer 2000 V2 In Depth Review & Warnings
cards.video_why: The title promises warnings as well as praise; it came from a search-result URL and we could not confirm the channel.

buy.pick: The Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 on its own (2,042 Wh), not a bundle unless the listing names every panel and you check the box on arrival
buy.check: Sold by Jackery or a big-box store; the name reads "2000 v2" (not the first-generation 2000 Plus or a smaller v2); a bundle that includes solar panels is only a deal if the panels are listed and in the box
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Dreame X50 Ultra
cards.price: List $1,599.99; Dreame's own store ran it at $799.99 (50% off) from Nov 20 to Dec 1, 2025 (Dreame's Black Friday 2025 post, via a search snippet). Our target: $800 or less.
cards.buy_if: you have thresholds or rugs to climb and a pet, and the price is near $800: the X60 Max Ultra Complete replaced it in February 2026, so this is a clearance-style buy.
cards.skip_if: you want the quietest, most trouble-free machine: owners are split, and a seller's discount does not fix a bad unit.
cards.owners: Reddit comments gathered by redditrecs.com were about 70% positive across 173 comments, with one poster (about May 2026) reporting four replacement units. Another owner logged about 35 hours with two long-haired dogs and no jams. Check the exact name: Ultra and Ultra Complete are different bundles.

cards.name: Roborock Saros 10R
cards.badge: Robot vacuum · buy it now if the price is right
cards.chip: Dual spinning pads · 3.14 in · omni dock
cards.price: List $1,599.99; Roborock's own store showed $899.99 on Oct 14, 2026. Black Friday 2025 was $999.99 (9to5Google, via a search snippet). Our target: $900 or less now.
cards.buy_if: you can get it near $900 today: October already beat last year's Black Friday price, and the Saros 20 replaced it on March 23, 2026, so waiting does not obviously help.
cards.skip_if: you want the newest model, or the listing says Saros 10 (without the R), which is a different machine with one vibrating pad.
cards.owners: Walmart showed 4.6 out of 5 from 260 reviews, according to a third-party site that checked on June 20, 2026 (not seen directly). Owners praise how rarely it needs rescuing; the faults reported are a clogging dock port in pet homes and, in a few Australian reviews, hardware errors after a month.

cards.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
cards.badge: Earbuds · do not wait for Black Friday
cards.price: List $249 (apple.com). Black Friday 2025 low: $219.99 at Walmart and Best Buy (TechBuzz, Nov 20, 2025). Walmart and Target were about $179–$180 on Oct 5, 2026 (a Slickdeals price table with inconsistent dates). Our target: $180 or less.
cards.buy_if: you use an iPhone and see about $180: that is already below last year's Black Friday low, and Best Buy went to $209.99 by February 2026 (Slickdeals).
cards.skip_if: fit has hurt you before: owners and reviewers (MacRumors forum, SoundGuys, Tom's Guide) report soreness or a loose seal for some ears, and a few report crackle or a screech that Apple could not reproduce.
cards.owners: Best Buy's new-unit page showed 4.8 out of 5 from about 11,400 reviews (snapshot, Oct 2026); its refurbished listing showed 4.13 from 45. RTINGS scored them 8.5 out of 10.

cards.name: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2
cards.badge: Power station · the 1 kWh to wait on
cards.price: List $799. Anker's own store sold it for $429 with a code in April 2026 (Slickdeals, Apr 23, 2026); a commenter claimed $349 around Black Friday 2025 (unconfirmed). Our target: $430 or less.
cards.buy_if: you want a quiet-ish 1 kWh unit for a UPS or the camper and the price is at or under about $430, which Anker has already shown it will do.
cards.skip_if: you expect to expand later (reviewers say there is no expansion battery) or you hate fan noise: reviewers say the fan gets loud during fast charging.
cards.owners: Retailers list it as the C1000X Gen2. Home Depot reviews were thin, and a Best Buy reviewer called the fan loud while charging fast (snapshots, Oct 2026). MacRumors left one at full charge for a month and found it still at 100%. We found no owner reports of months of use.

cards.name: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus
cards.badge: Power station · no proof Black Friday beats spring
cards.price: List $799 (Slickdeals, 2025). Wellbots sold it for $540.94 on Jan 17, 2025 and $534.65 on Apr 19, 2025 (Slickdeals). We found no sourced Black Friday 2025 price. Our target: $550 or less.
cards.buy_if: you want the fastest recharge in this size (about an hour to full, per reviewers) and the price is near $535–$550, where it has been before.
cards.skip_if: you want a silent UPS: The Solar Lab saw the fans cycle on and off and logged internal temperatures up to 138°F in a heavy test, and T3 said the fans ran as soon as the AC port was on.
cards.owners: We found no owner threads or retailer reviews we could read. The complaints above come from professional reviewers (The Solar Lab, T3, Output Report), not from owners. Check that the listing says Plus, not the plain DELTA 3.

cards.name: LG C6 OLED (65-inch)
cards.badge: TV · the one big-ticket pick with a pattern
cards.price: A Best Buy price of $1,599.99 for the 65-inch was reported in September 2026 (TechRadar summary, unconfirmed); LG's own July 2026 sale listed $1,800 (was $2,600) (9to5Toys, Jul 26, 2026). Last year the C5 65-inch hit $1,296.99 at Walmart (TechRadar). Our target: about $1,500 or less.
cards.buy_if: you want a bright, well-reviewed OLED and see the full model code OLED65C6PUA: RTINGS calls it the value OLED, and last year's model fell about 50% below list around Black Friday.
cards.skip_if: you watch mostly static content for hours (RTINGS flags burn-in risk) or the deal names a different, stripped-down model code. Retailers sometimes sell doorbuster variants that cannot be price-matched.
cards.owners: Walmart's page for the 65-inch showed 4.8 out of 5 from 861 ratings (snapshot, Oct 2026). Complaints were the remote, ads on the home screen and one slow support case. What Hi-Fi found most C5 sizes hit record lows in June 2026, so the low is not always in November.

cards.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
cards.badge: Earbuds · no Black Friday history yet
cards.price: List $329.99. First sale was about 10% off in March 2026; the best discount we saw was about 22% off list on Oct 5, 2026 (SoundGuys). Our target: $260 or less, which is about 20% off.
cards.buy_if: you want the best-sounding Sony yet and can wait: it launched in 2026, so there is no Black Friday record to lean on.
cards.skip_if: you value call quality and noise cancelling over sound: Engadget and TechRadar both say rivals have caught up, and What Hi-Fi testers were less sure of the seal.
cards.owners: Best Buy's black pair showed 4.4 out of 5 from about 320 reviews, with the bulky case, uncomfortable foam tips and a large fit as the complaints (snapshot, Oct 2026). The Review Bench reported accidental track skips from the touch controls after six weeks. We found no long-term owner threads.

cards.video_why: A head-to-head with the AirPods Pro 3, the two earbuds on this page; the title came from a search-result URL.

cards.name: Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2)
cards.badge: Smart glasses · do not count on a cut
cards.chip: 12 MP camera · open-ear audio · Meta AI
cards.price: List $379. Meta's summer sale took Gen 2 15% off (May 14–25, 2026); Best Buy showed $322.15 for one style on May 19 (MacRumors). The Gen 3 launched Sept 23, 2026 from $449 and Gen 2 was still at full price on Oct 10 (iDevice). Our target: $325 or less.
cards.buy_if: you want the camera and music and see $325 or less, which would match the best 2026 discount.
cards.skip_if: you expect a clearance: Gen 3 has not cut Gen 2's price so far, and we found no evidence that it will. If you want the longer battery, the Gen 3 adds about one hour.
cards.owners: Best Buy's Wayfarer Gen 2 page showed 4.7 out of 5 from about 1,690 reviews (snapshot, Oct 2026); complaints were frame size, weight at the nose and Transitions lenses. Android Central measured about 20% battery drain an hour under heavy use.

cards.name: Apple AirTag 2 (4-pack)
cards.badge: Tracker · a small buy that barely moves
cards.price: List $99 for four, $29 for one (MacRumors, Aug 24, 2026). Target had the 4-pack at $89.99 in October 2026 (The Points Guy). It launched in January 2026, so there is no Black Friday record. Our target: $80 or less.
cards.buy_if: you are on an iPhone and need several trackers: $80 or less would be about 20% off list.
cards.skip_if: you own first-generation AirTags: MacRumors says do not upgrade, and Tom's Guide measured range of about 74 ft against about 50 ft, which most people will not notice.
cards.owners: Best Buy's 4-pack page showed 4.9 out of 5 from a few hundred reviews (snapshot, Oct 2026); owners liked the range and louder speaker, and a few called it a modest upgrade. Do not mix it up with the first-generation 4-pack page, which has its own reviews.

cards.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40
cards.badge: Jump starter · about $80 is the usual deal
cards.chip: 1,000 A · up to 6.0 L gas · 3.0 L diesel
cards.price: List $99.95 (NOCO). Woot sold it for $79.95 on Aug 26, 2025 (Slickdeals). That has been the common deal price for two years, and we found no Black Friday 2025 price at a store other than Amazon. Our target: about $80.
cards.buy_if: you want a glovebox jump starter for a car or small SUV and see $80 or so: it does not usually go lower, so there is nothing to wait for.
cards.skip_if: you drive a big truck or diesel (AutoGuide says its engine claims are optimistic) or you will not recharge it every few months: lithium packs lose charge in storage.
cards.owners: Home Depot showed 4.6 out of 5 from 628 reviews and Walmart 4.6 from 788 (snapshots, Oct 2026). Reviewers mention a missing charger and a hard-to-read manual, and one said the case swelled just after the one-year warranty ended. A Bushcraft USA owner found one red LED after about 3.5 months (Mar 2025).

cards.name: REDTIGER F7NP dash cam
cards.badge: Dash cam · the sticker price is the trap
cards.price: List $149.98 with the $129.99 sticker common (Android Authority, Jul 28, 2026). A Slickdeals commenter said the "$129.99 sale" was not the real street price (Oct 14, 2025). Our target: $100 or less.
cards.buy_if: you want a two-camera setup cheaply and see $100 or less, and you will buy a good microSD card.
cards.skip_if: you want a camera you never think about: owners report SD-card errors, a mount that lets go in heat and app trouble, and we found no independent expert test.
cards.owners: Walmart showed 4.3 out of 5, and one reviewer said it stopped recording after about two months with an SD-card error (snapshot, Oct 2026). A Team-BHP owner said the suction mount came off after three months. redditrecs.com showed about 75% positive across 101 comments (Sept 2026).
